analysis: Examined the modified ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift (base text lines 1-1046 plus patch). Changes: (1) ensureModelLoaded at base line 207 swaps the gate autopilotAllowsModel -> autopilotServesModel (head line 207). The Autopilot command-bound override clause (commandId/loadModelId match) is unchanged, and the checkAutopilotLoadOwnership calls remain. Whether autopilotServesModel is stricter or looser than autopilotAllowsModel cannot be verified because its definition is outside the supplied evidence; it is an integration question for the unit where it is defined. (2) Head 1146-1148 adds reconcileAutopilotPlacements() immediately after modelSlots.removeValue and modelsUnloading.remove, so a model leaving residency ends any Autopilot placement before later awaits. This narrows a reload race and is not a regression by itself. (3) Head 1296-1304 adds `!autopilotHoldsModel($0.key, now:)` to evictableModelSlots, so Autopilot-held slots are not evicted. This is fail-safe for eviction. The residual availability risk is that a held slot could block slot-cap or memory admission; the hold is time-bounded by the `now` parameter and is created only by a settled operation, per the new comment. The weight-hash TOCTOU bracketing, SSD cache eligibility (cacheEligibleWeightHash only on verified equal pre/post hashes), markWeightHashUnavailable and the GLM paths are unchanged context. They keep the T-041, T-012 and T-027 mitigations, with no weakening observed. No changes to encryption, attestation or coordinator-provider authorization boundaries in this file. Remaining questions: the semantics of autopilotServesModel, autopilotHoldsModel and reconcileAutopilotPlacements, and whether reconcileAutopilotPlacements re-enters the actor or the load gate unsafely. These are defined in files outside this batch. The patch excerpt is truncated at the evictableModelSlots tail, so the rest of that function was not seen.
